snippet.title: Miami Hotel Simulator - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1936810/Miami_Hotel_Simulator/
Transform and manage your dream hotel in vibrant Miami! Renovate your property, delight your guests, and boost your income. Expand your offerings with vending machines and food services to become the ultimate hospitality tycoon!
